data.reference: fixture SRT timings, not precise acoustic-onset ground truth
data.trackingReference: Correlated playback-time samples after first lock, including unknown regions at zero automatic delay. Ideal fixture transform, not independent acoustic annotations.

data.scope: native PCM/ASR and domain tracking only; no production controller or renderer claim

limitations: This is a local development regression with older c734 mpv, not the currently shipped app-linked native package.
No production controller, native renderer, backward seek or audible playback was exercised.
The expected edit transform was read only after inference and was not supplied to matching or fitting.
Caption times are not independently annotated acoustic onsets.
The legacy native probe uses a constant-offset assertion; the separate scene assessment is authoritative for piecewise scoring.
The added-scene run overlapped a short independent fixture mux verification; this is not a controlled performance benchmark.
